{{Quote|&mdash;who will choose its members, according to rule 729900, subsection B38 of the subcommittee rules&mdash;|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bog Divinian]]|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />}}
'''Rule 729900''' or '''Seven Hundred and Twenty-Nine Thousand Nine Hundred''' was a regulation that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] used. Subsection B38 of the rule concerned Senate subcommittees.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" /> In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> it was reviewed by [[Sano Sauro]], the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eeropha]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rule 729900 appeared in the young adult novel ''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]'', the ninth volume in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|''Jedi Quest'']] series written by [[Jude Watson]] and released in [[2004]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace" />
